title: Memo: the DOJ says federal employees can now download TikTok on government devices, citing ByteDance's transfer of control of US operations to TikTok USDS (David Shepardson/Reuters)
summary: David Shepardson / Reuters: Memo: the DOJ says federal employees can now download TikTok on government devices, citing ByteDance's transfer of control of US operations to TikTok USDS — The U.S. Justice Department said on Friday that federal employees can now download the short-video app TikTok on government devices.
